# Components by provider

<!-- generated by components/alignment.test.ts (UPDATE_COMPONENTS_DOC=1 npm run components:doc): do not edit by hand -->

The contract has **57** components: the whole gluestack catalogue. flipova implements all of them in plain React Native. For every other provider a component is either **native** (the library’s own component, with the design applied) or **flipova** (the flipova one is rendered instead, so `@flipova/foundation/ui` always has the whole set). **RN** marks components that are React Native itself (View, ScrollView, FlatList, Image…): no library replaces them, so the adapters that do not wrap their own serve the same ones (`providers/rn-base`).

| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| flipova | 57 | 43 | 14 | 0 |
| gluestack | 31 | 31 | 0 | 26 |
| reusables | 31 | 19 | 12 | 26 |
| paper | 31 | 17 | 14 | 26 |
| tamagui | 32 | 20 | 12 | 25 |
